question:
Study the given diagram and answer the question that follows.

The hexagon represents Females.

The circle represents Writers.

The quadrilateral represents Bengali.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa3e0cde546dc1b2fa7f2c38b466c4e057687cdc9d09ac0c3ec714764efeb244.png] 

How many female writers are Bengali?
solution:
According to the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33faa664bb322c9e63f56dc9102f3cd07d3b1281afd4864c9b9f1aba658543d1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edfb5f598b440d962a96025e11fda549013db04cb66991387ae02a029b60e38d.png] 

Thus, female writers are Bengali = 15.

Hence, the correct answer is** "15".**
